title: Delete Middle Node
statement:
Implement an algorithm to delete a node in the middle (i.e., any node but
the first and last node, not necessarily the exact middle) of a singly linked list, given only access to
that node.

hints.#72: Picture the list 1->5->9->12. Removing 9 would make it look like 1->5->12. You only have access to the 9 node. Can you make it look like the correct answer?

constraints-and-assumptions: We don't have access to the ssl.head (the head/first node of the list)
assume it is a singly linked list of any valid python type (including individual lowercase letters as shown in the example)

examples.explanation: Degenerate test case. Null singly linked list.

tests.explanation: Degenerate test case. Null singly linked list.
